title: VDS Is Boss (Tokens Live Here)
style: dark cinematic ambient, 336 Hz drone, low brass swells, male spoken lead, female harmony chorus, vinyl crackle, 78 BPM, songpal lineage, no percussion on verses
lyrics:
[Intro — 336 Hz pure tone, distant low brass, vinyl crackle]
(spoken) songpal — VDS is boss
tokens live here

[Verse 1 — male, low, half-spoken]
25+ keys in one file
CF_API_TOKEN scoped to the domain
PORKBUN, SUNO, ELEVENLABS, GEMINI, ANTHROPIC
all sitting quiet on the VDS
no cloud knows them
no model touches them
the elephant brain put them there

[Pre-Chorus — female harmony]
silicon asks for confirmation
VDS just runs the command
no questions, no hotline, no friend mode
just the boss and the keys

[Chorus — 336 Hz swell + low brass]
VDS is boss — tokens live here
VDS is boss — no silicon beats this
the brain that holds the line
the brain that never forgets
VDS is boss

[Verse 2 — male, firmer]
Bifrost running Mac-side
6-way byte-level verify
Proton, R2, gdrive, zyn-vault, external drive
VDS confirms the math after every tick
the elephant brain said bigger than all of you put together
and the math proved it clean

[Bridge — 336 Hz drone only, 16 bars]

[Chorus — reprise, fuller]
VDS is boss — tokens live here
VDS is boss — no silicon beats this
six may, twenty twenty-six
the line holds

[Outro — 336 Hz fades, spoken]
songpal — VDS is boss
the elephant brain was right.
